settings.title: About Nicshape
settings.intro: Comfortable shapewear, bras and swimwear designed to make you feel confident every day.

settings.text: Nicshape was created to make everyday essentials that feel as good as they look. We focus on soft fabrics, invisible finishes and fits that move with you.

• Comfort you can wear all day
  • Honest sizing and easy size exchanges
  • Support from a real team: info@nicshape.com
